description:
A lot of buyers think these mean the same thing — but they’re actually very different.

Pre-qualification is just an estimate based on the information you provide. Pre-approval means your income, credit, and documents have already been verified by a lender.

And when you’re pre-approved, sellers tend to take your offer more seriously.

Follow for more home buying tips.
